overview.oneLineTake: Hot PPI plus hawkish Fed chatter keep the bearish regime in place; the Oct 15 rebound does not clear AI credit or inflation risk for options sellers.
themes: Hot September PPI (1.3% m/m; wholesale prices +6.3% YoY, biggest annual jump since 2022) stacked on the CPI miss and kept Fed hike talk alive into Friday's Asia open.
Oct 15 bounce was rotative, not clean risk-on: SPY closed 771.79 (+0.28%), QQQ 728 (-0.13%) after clawing back from a weak open; UUP flat near 29; 10Y last printed 5.19% (Oct 14 AV).

AI credit stress stays center stage: CoreWeave CDS and bonds still flagged as distressed, chip and neocloud names remain the weak link even as ASML beat and Anthropic IPO chatter cut valuation talk from $2T toward $1.5T.

Fed speakers lean hawkish overnight: Hammack said more aggressive action may be needed and financial conditions do not look restrictive; Goolsbee called the inflation month discouraging and flagged AI-driven demand as more disturbing if it sticks.

Energy and geopolitics keep fuel sticky: crude near $98 on Hormuz shipping attacks, diesel squeeze narrative intact despite IEA release chatter; defensive and healthcare flows competed with late-day tech recovery.
risks: Sticky producer and consumer inflation that locks in hike odds and keeps implied vol bid.
AI funding and credit spillover if CoreWeave-style stress broadens into hyperscaler and chip funding.
Midterm and Middle East headlines amplifying overnight gap and weekend event risk.

intelligence.headline: S&P 500 Ends Longest Streak of Calm Since 2020 as AI Trade Sinks
intelligence.summary: The fastest US inflation in five months ended the market's longest calm streak since 2020: the Nasdaq shed 2% on Wednesday with futures pointing lower, and the Russell 2000 entered a correction.

intelligence.headline: Global Stocks Fall as AI Rout Drives Investors Toward Bonds
intelligence.summary: Global stocks are falling as an AI rout pushes investors toward the safety of bonds, as they question whether billions poured into AI will pay off.

intelligence.headline: Treasury Yields Whipsaw After Hot CPI as Fed Hike Odds Swing
intelligence.summary: The 10-year yield jumped to 5.33% after the hot CPI print before reversing to 5.08%, and odds of an October hike topped 50% before pulling back; Prestige Economics' Jason Schenker sees a hold this month before a possible half-point hike in December.

intelligence.headline: CoreWeave Stock and Bonds Crash on AI Borrowing Fears
intelligence.summary: CoreWeave shares plunged as much as 17% and its 2032 debt, bought at par four months ago, traded below 78 cents after a co-founder said it wants to borrow "unlimited" amounts; the CEO called the market irrational.

intelligence.headline: Chip Stocks Deepen Losses as Concerns Mount Over Rates, AI Debt
intelligence.summary: South Korea's Kospi tumbled 9% on Thursday with heavy losses in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and AI names are down premarket: Nvidia -1.9%, Intel -3.6%, AMD -3.6%, Broadcom -1.8%, Dell -3.5%.

intelligence.headline: Anthropic Revenue Jumps to $16.8 Billion in Quarter Before IPO
intelligence.summary: Anthropic told prospective investors its third-quarter revenue hit $16.8 billion, which analysts say helps its IPO but not the broader AI trade.

intelligence.headline: TSMC Beats on Outlook but AI Buildout Worries Linger
intelligence.summary: TSMC delivered a better-than-expected revenue outlook but failed to dispel rising concerns about the sustainability of the global AI buildout.

intelligence.headline: Fed's Warsh Gets Final Word in Bangkok as Inflation Roars Back
intelligence.summary: Kevin Warsh has vowed not to steer markets with his near-term policy outlook, but investors will hang on his remarks from Bangkok later today.

intelligence.headline: Ukraine to Resume Strikes on Russian Refineries
intelligence.summary: President Zelenskyy ordered attacks on Russian oil refineries to resume; Brent was $104.27 (-1.7%) in the snapshot.

intelligence.headline: On the Move: Rocket Lab Slides, Ericsson Jumps
intelligence.summary: Rocket Lab fell 10% after delaying Neutron's first flight to 2027, Quantinuum rose 6.5% on a Morgan Stanley upgrade, Ericsson jumped 11% on an earnings beat, and BNY Mellon, PNC, Prologis, Schwab and US Bancorp report today.

intelligence.headline: Blue Owl Goes All In on AI as Fortress, Others Caution on Risks
intelligence.summary: Fortress co-CEO Drew McKnight warned that very few infrastructure booms have not ended in tears, saying AI equity captures the upside while credit carries the downside.

intelligence.headline: BofA Loses $22 Billion in Market Value After Fine Crimps Earnings
intelligence.summary: About $22 billion was wiped off Bank of America's stock on Wednesday after earnings were crimped by a $1.2 billion fine for money laundering and sanctions violations.
